doc_name: List of awards and nominations received by John Williams
text: John Williams has received 54 Academy Award nominations, winning 5; 6 Emmy Awards, winning 3; 26 Golden Globe Awards, winning 4; 76 Grammy Awards, winning 26; 16 British Academy Film Awards, winning 7; and 23 Saturn Awards, winning 10. In 2022, he was appointed an Honorary Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire (KBE) by Queen Elizabeth II "for services to film music." With 54 Oscar nominations, Williams holds the record for the most Oscar nominations by a living person, and is the second most nominated individual in Academy Awards history behind Walt Disney, who has 59 nominations; he is also the only person in Academy history to have received nominations in seven consecutive decades. Forty-eight of his Oscar nominations were for Best Original Score, and five were for Best Original Song; he won four Oscars for Best Original Score and one for Best Scoring: Adaptation and Original Song Score (Fiddler on the Roof). Williams has won Grammy Awards for Best Instrumental Composition and Best Score Soundtrack for Visual Media multiple times for his scores in Star Wars, Close Encounters of the Third Kind, Superman, The Empire Strikes Back, E.T. the Extraterrestrial, Munich, Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull, The Book Thief, The Force Awakens, and Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny. The Grammy competition includes composers of instrumental music from any genre.
